newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish airlines LOT traffic up 10.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish airlines LOT traffic up 10.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Poland's national airlines PLL LOT SA flew 2.03 million people last year, up 10.5 percent from 1995 and transported 22,700 tonnes of air cargo, up 19 percent, LOT said in a statement on Wednesday.
LOT said it planed to fly 2.3 million people this year.
It said the number of passangers on international charter flights increased 81.7 percent last year to 122,600 people.
Scheduled international flights' passangers increased 6.5 percent to 1.6 million while domestic flight pasangers rose 15.5 percent to 311,000 last year.
LOT said that 67.5 percent of passanger seats were used last year, down from 69.6 percent occupancy in 1995.
